title: Ashley R NDE 9205
content: I was at my grandma's house watching TV and then, the next thing I know, I was back home in Virginia but with relatives who had passed away and with some who were still alive. I didn't see a bright light or a tunnel. I felt nothing but just an amazing love. I've slowly lost some details over time, but I also saw some weird-looking men who were not human and they were watching us. I woke up in the hospital and was told my heart stopped and I had died for over 4 minutes. Yet to me, my time out of my body seemed like forever. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 2014 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes. Heart attack. Out of body experience How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I was more alert to my surroundings At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? While I was with my grandpa, who was dead. I felt like I knew I was dead but when I woke up, I didn't realize that I had died. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. Time was slower on earth. Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was like flashes of light and then different locations and points of time. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Same Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I saw my dead relatives and live relatives like normal. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Extremely happy and loved Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? I remembered many past events Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Atheist What is your religion now? Unaffiliated- Atheist Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. I saw little men that were clearly not men that told me I wasn't ready to go home. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I can't explain How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain I feel like I know when things are going to happen now. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Getting to spend time with my grandad again and be told how he feels about me. And knowing our loved ones are still there! Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I've told a couple people. They think I was dreaming. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No Did the questions asked and information that you provided accurately and comprehensively describe your experience? Uncertain

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw "some weird-looking men who were not human" / "little men that were clearly not men" who were watching them and told her she "wasn't ready to go home."

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Told by non-human "little men" that she "wasn't ready to go home."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Heart attack; reported heart stopped and she "had died for over 4 minutes."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Flashes of light with different locations/points of time; non-human "little men" watching and speaking.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel or bright light; experience began with a sudden shift from grandma's house to being "back home in Virginia" with deceased and living relatives.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Presence of both deceased relatives and relatives who were still alive in the same setting; "weird-looking men who were not human" watching them; perception described as "flashes of light and then different locations and points of time."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I didn't see a bright light or a tunnel. I felt nothing but just an amazing love."; "I saw little men that were clearly not men that told me I wasn't ready to go home."; "Yet to me, my time out of my body seemed like forever."
